ask.title: Answers staff in every department
ask.desc: Ask in plain words. WikiAI finds the answer in your connected systems and shows where it came from.

turns.question: What discount can we give a wholesale client on coffee machines?
turns.answer: 7% from 10 units, 12% from 30 units. There are 46 coffee machines in stock, ready to ship tomorrow.

turns.question: What if the client picks it up themselves?
turns.answer: Then add another 2% for pickup. The Minsk warehouse is open 9:00 to 20:00.

turns.question: A customer wants to return a vacuum 10 days after buying it. Is that allowed?
turns.answer: Yes, returns are accepted within 14 days if the box and receipt are kept. The return is handled at the pickup point.

turns.question: What if they lost the receipt?
turns.answer: Find the order in 1C by the customer's phone number and print a copy of the receipt. The return goes through with it.

turns.question: Which warehouse has the most R7 robot vacuums?
turns.answer: Gomel has 12, Minsk 4 and Brest 2. The next delivery arrives on October 3.

turns.question: How long is a transfer from Gomel to Minsk?
turns.answer: 2 business days. The truck between warehouses leaves on Tuesdays and Fridays.

turns.question: How do I request time off?
turns.answer: Submit a request in Bitrix24 at least 2 weeks ahead. Your manager approves it within 3 business days.

turns.question: Who approves it if my manager is on leave?
turns.answer: Their deputy. The request moves to them automatically.

clients.title: Answers customers 24/7
clients.desc: In your website chat, on Telegram and by phone. When a person is needed, it hands the conversation to your team.
clients.question: How long does delivery to Grodno take?
clients.answer: By courier in 1-2 business days for 9 BYN. Delivery is free for orders over 150 BYN.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Anything else? We'll answer it when we discuss the pilot.

items.a: Bitrix24, 1C, documents in PDF, Word and Excel, Google Drive, Confluence, email, Telegram and OpenCart. Other systems and AI agents connect through the API.

items.q: Do we need a developer to set it up?
items.a: No. Systems connect through ready-made connectors, and during the pilot we help you set everything up.

items.q: How does the data stay up to date?
items.a: Automatically. When prices and stock change in 1C, deals in Bitrix24 or your documents, WikiAI picks up the changes on its own.

items.q: What if WikiAI gets an answer wrong?
items.a: WikiAI answers only from your data and shows the source of every answer, so it's easy to check. If there's no reliable answer, WikiAI says so.

items.q: Where is our data stored, and who can see it?
items.a: Each company's data is stored separately, in our cloud or on your own servers. Only your staff can see it, with role-based access.

items.q: Can we connect our phone system?
items.a: Yes. WikiAI connects to your PBX over SIP: it answers customers by voice and prompts your team during calls. Your numbers and call routing stay the same.

cta.title: Bring your company's knowledge into one place
cta.subtitle: Two weeks on your real data: we connect your systems and your team starts getting answers. Then you decide.
